comment: The contracts the UI reads (REQ-UI-001; A258). Three entry points are generated to ui/src/contract_types: customer.ts (the four public contracts, errors.v3, message-request.v1, the one body the page sends, and conversation-response.v1, the answer to it: all a customer-facing page may import) and operator.ts (the customer set plus the operator and auditor contracts, among them reconstruction.v3 and record-event.v3, which carry tenant_id, the full events and their hashes) and benchmark.ts (the benchmark UI only, REQ-UI-004, A250: scorecard-view.v1, the aggregate numbers of a run with no case id, oracle reference or failure list, INV-22; it reaches no customer or operator contract and neither of those reaches it; operator.ts does not include it). Each root is generated as TypeScript types and parsers with every contract it refers to; a contract the UI does not read is not listed, so it does not reach the client bundle.
